//! Writes the type change fixtures with a build from before the change
//! rewrote its layers. usage: retype_fixtures <out dir>

use std::path::Path;

use stoolap::test_failpoints as fp;
use stoolap::Database;

fn dsn(dir: &Path) -> String {
    format!(
        "file://{}?checkpoint_interval=3600&compact_threshold=1000",
        dir.display()
    )
}

/// The files as they stand, as a crash would leave them
fn crash_image(from: &Path, to: &Path) {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(to).unwrap();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(from).unwrap() {
        let entry = entry.unwrap();
        let target = to.join(entry.file_name());
        if entry.file_type().unwrap().is_dir() {
            crash_image(&entry.path(), &target);
        } else if entry.file_name() != "db.lock" {
            std::fs::copy(entry.path(), target).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&out).unwrap();

    // 1. Volumes holding INTEGER under a TEXT schema
    let dir = out.join("old_typed_volumes");
    let db = Database::open(&dsn(&dir)).unwrap();
    db.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, k INTEGER UNIQUE)",
        (),
    )
    .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 7), (2, 8)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("PRAGMA CHECKPOINT", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k TEXT", ()).unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();

    // 2. Volumes holding '7' and '07' as TEXT under an INTEGER schema
    let dir = out.join("colliding_volumes");
    let db = Database::open(&dsn(&dir)).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, k TEXT UNIQUE)", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, '7')", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("PRAGMA CHECKPOINT", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (2, '07')", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("PRAGMA CHECKPOINT", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k INTEGER", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();

    // 3. A WAL holding row 2, then the change, then row 2's marker
    let dir = out.join("work_row_alter_marker");
    let db = Database::open(&dsn(&dir)).unwrap();
    db.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, k INTEGER UNIQUE)",
        (),
    )
    .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 7)", ()).unwrap();
    let other = db.clone();
    fp::before_commit_marker(move || {
        other
            .execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k TEXT", ())
            .unwrap();
    });
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (2, 8)", ()).unwrap();
    crash_image(&dir, &out.join("row_alter_marker"));
    drop(db);
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();

    // 4. A WAL holding '007', a change to INTEGER and one back to TEXT
    let dir = out.join("work_text_integer_text");
    let db = Database::open(&dsn(&dir)).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, k TEXT)", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, '007')", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k INTEGER", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k TEXT", ()).unwrap();
    crash_image(&dir, &out.join("text_integer_text"));
    drop(db);
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();

    // 5. A WAL holding '7' and '07' in a TEXT UNIQUE column, then a change to
    // INTEGER that makes them equal
    let dir = out.join("work_hot_colliding");
    let db = Database::open(&dsn(&dir)).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, k TEXT UNIQUE)", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, '7'), (2, '07')", ())
        .unwrap();
    db.execute("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN k INTEGER", ())
        .unwrap();
    crash_image(&dir, &out.join("hot_colliding"));
    drop(db);
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
}
